history.summary: Neighbourhood Shiva temple on Pani House Road, Vishal Gaon, Gangtok (a few steps above the Black Cat Division Gurudwara), beside the highway but peaceful inside per visitor reviews; rated 4.7/5 on listing sites. No published history, founder, or construction date found - thin documentation; flag antiquity as unverified. Reviewers note an aura of pious divinity, amicable people, and free snacks served during Shivratri. CSV name verified against the listing name 'Shree Siddheshwar Shiv Mandir, Pani House'. name: Shri Siddheshwar Shiv Mandir (Pani House)
town: Gangtok (Pani House / Vishal Gaon area, on Pani House Road off NH-10)
town_description: Vishal Gaon / Pani House is a residential-commercial pocket on the NH-10 corridor just below central Gangtok, near Deorali and Tadong. It is a busy highway-side neighbourhood of lodges, the Black Cat Division Gurudwara, and small shrines serving local devotees rather than the tourist circuit.

travel.road: On Pani House Road at Vishal Gaon, beside NH-10; a short city-taxi ride from MG Marg (verify).
